description: 한국수력원자력(주)_연도별 원자력발전소 구조물 장기검사 계획 [nuclear facilities and electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수력원자력(주). 1열(구분): 국내 원자력 발전소 구분하여 작성 2열(텐돈타입): 국내 원자력발전소 텐돈타입 종류별로 구분하여 작성(부착식, 비부착식 텐돈 타입, 고리 1,2호기 텐돈 무) 3열. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국수력원자력(주). Its tags are 원자력발전소가동중검사, 원전구조물검사, 원전정기점검, 원전주기점검, 가동중검사. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
